description:
About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. Our multi-agent platform assesses complex business systems, designs their future state and executes change with greater speed, consistency and control.

We combine enterprise systems expertise with product engineering to address fragmented data, custom development, interconnected processes and years of accumulated business decisions.

Our architects shape both customer outcomes and the platform itself. Their expertise becomes reusable capabilities, so each engagement benefits from the lessons of the last.

The Opportunity

As our SAP Record-to-Report Architect, you will shape how customers transform their finance operations, with a particular focus on ECC-to-S/4HANA programs.

You will own R2R architecture across financial and management accounting, period-end close, reconciliation and the integration of finance with operational processes.

Much of this work starts with finance estates built up since R/3: classic GL configurations, spreadsheet-dependent close processes, custom Z-reports, reconciliation gaps and legacy enterprise structures. You will lead customers in distinguishing essential accounting requirements from historical workarounds and establish a finance design their teams can operate and trust.

Working directly with product and engineering teams, you will turn field experience into better assessments, stronger reconciliation checks and reusable platform capabilities. Success means a defensible architecture, a reliable financial close and sustained adoption, delivered with customer finance leaders and Tessera’s delivery teams.

What You Will Own

R2R Architecture and Design

  • Own R2R solution design, architectural recommendations and domain acceptance criteria, aligned with the Principal Solution Architect’s overall solution accountability.

  • Lead decisions across enterprise structures, charts of accounts, ledgers, accounting principles, currencies, document splitting, Asset Accounting, Controlling, allocations, intercompany accounting and close.

  • Define financial and management reporting, including profit center, segment and profitability reporting.

  • Define how postings from sales, procurement, inventory, production and maintenance reach the ledger, with the owning process architects.

  • Guide configuration and development teams, review functional specifications and document architectural decisions.

ECC-to-S/4HANA Transformation

  • Lead finance discovery across configuration, custom development, interfaces, data quality, reconciliation gaps and close dependencies.

  • Recommend the R2R implications of system conversion, selective data transition or new implementation, and translate simplification items and readiness findings into scope, dependencies and remediation plans.

  • Guide decisions on the Universal Journal, Asset Accounting, cost-element integration, Material Ledger, Margin Analysis and Business Partner conversion, appropriate to the target release and deployment model.

  • Define how balances, open items, assets and relevant historical detail are converted or migrated, validated and reconciled.

  • Assess the future consolidation landscape, including Group Reporting or external consolidation platforms.

Controlled Delivery and Adoption

  • Define finance test scenarios and acceptance criteria covering integrated postings, parallel accounting, allocations, valuation, reporting and close.

  • Lead mock-conversion reconciliation, finance cutover readiness and first-close support.

  • Partner with controls, audit and security teams on approval workflows, segregation of duties, traceability and evidence requirements.

  • Apply fit-to-standard and clean-core principles with technical architects.

  • Work with customer leaders to establish ownership of critical finance master data and reporting structures.

  • Drive adoption through practical knowledge transfer and resolution of the issues that prevent finance teams from trusting the new processes.

Platform and Product Development

  • Work with Tessera’s AI agents and engineers while retaining accountable architectural judgment.

  • Define validation checks, exception criteria and human review points for AI-assisted finance work.

  • Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable rules, design patterns and controls, and validate platform outputs against customer evidence.

  • Support pre-sales with realistic assessments of scope, effort, dependencies and risk.

How You Will Work

You will lead R2R architecture across concurrent engagements, with involvement varying by project stage. You will work with Technical Program Managers on priorities, dependencies and capacity, and with configuration, development and delivery teams on implementation.

Your core expertise should be in FI/CO and the R2R process. You will set boundaries with the OTC, P2P, Plan-to-Produce and EAM architects on the postings their processes create, and involve treasury, tax and consolidation specialists where deeper expertise is needed.

We value hands-on investigation, clear recommendations and early escalation of risks and competing milestones, particularly around cutover and period-end close.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of SAP finance experience, including architectural leadership across complex transformations.

  • At least one completed S/4HANA finance implementation or conversion, including go-live and the first financial close.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in General Ledger, ledger design, Asset Accounting, core Controlling, allocations, settlement, intercompany accounting and period-end close.

  • Strong understanding of parallel accounting, multi-currency and multi-entity environments, and financial reporting under IFRS and/or US GAAP.

  • Practical command of the Universal Journal, compatibility views, finance data migration, reconciliation and cutover.

  • Strong command of finance integration with logistics, including postings from sales, procurement, inventory and production.

  • Experience making fit-to-standard decisions and evaluating extensions with technical architects.

  • The ability to communicate architectural trade-offs to controllers, CFOs, architects and engineers.

  • Evidence of sustained adoption, effective knowledge transfer and sound delivery across concurrent engagements.

  • Strong business English and effective collaboration across distributed teams.

  • The ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and assess its outputs critically. Within your first months, you will independently use Tessera’s platform to lead R2R assessments and contribute reusable improvements.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Experience We Value

Depth in one or more of the following is welcome:

  • Product costing, Material Ledger and actual costing.

  • SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting, intercompany matching and reconciliation, or external consolidation platforms.

  • Advanced Financial Closing or close and reconciliation tools such as BlackLine.

  • Central Finance and phased finance transformation approaches.

  • Treasury, Cash Management, Bank Account Management and bank connectivity.

  • Global statutory reporting, local GAAP and country-specific requirements.

  • S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and Public Edition.

  • SAP Activate, SAP certifications or accounting qualifications.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Build working fluency in Tessera’s platform, understand your customer portfolio and establish R2R priorities, risks and decision ownership.

By 90 days: Lead assigned engagements with documented recommendations, agreed priorities and clear reconciliation and acceptance criteria. Feed field insights into platform improvements.

First year: Customer-validated milestones, reliable financial closes where programs reach production, sustained adoption and reusable platform capabilities used across engagements, measured against customer-agreed baselines for close duration, reconciliation exceptions and manual journal volume.

Why Join Tessera

  • Own consequential finance architecture decisions with access to customer business and technology leaders.

  • Influence a product as well as individual implementations.

  • Work with engineers building AI-assisted enterprise transformation capabilities.

  • Turn hard-earned SAP experience into improvements that benefit multiple customers.

  • Help build the practices and standards of a growing Center of Excellence.

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.
